tier: Free plan, usage over $5 monthly CPU credit

free_tier.stated: The Free plan is $0 and includes $5.00 a month of CPU Functions and CPU Sandboxes usage, with GPU Functions and GPU Sandboxes, custom domains and 3 cron jobs; detailed compute and storage rates are in the estimator.
free_tier.notes: The $5 monthly CPU credit is the recurring free allowance. CPU Functions and CPU Sandboxes are $0.00001667 per GB-second plus $0.20 per million requests and $0.09 per GB of bandwidth out. GPU Sandboxes are $0.0000126 per vCPU-second, $0.00000137 per GB-second and $0.00013067 per GPU-second. The Pro plan is $20 a month with $20 of usage and 20 GB of model storage; the operator's price list puts Buildfunctions at $0.24 an hour.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a machine, not an object. GPU Sandboxes can be raised to 75 GB memory and 50 vCPUs on the Free and Pro plans; model storage beyond the included amount is $0.39 per GB-month.

retention.stated: A sandbox can run for up to 24 hours; retention of files after a run ends is not stated on the pricing or introduction pages and is unverified: behind a sign-up.

egress.terms: CPU Functions and CPU Sandboxes bill bandwidth out at $0.09 per GB, and GPU Functions and GPU Sandboxes bill bandwidth out at $0.09 per GB; inbound traffic is not priced on the page. The estimator exposes bandwidth out as a billable input for both sandbox classes.

interface_detail: Sandboxes are created through an SDK and deployed from the dashboard; the docs describe CPUSandbox and GPUSandbox primitives and an SDK for sandboxing agent actions. No SSH endpoint is published on the read pages.
tooling: the Buildfunctions SDK with CPUFunction, GPUFunction, CPUSandbox and GPUSandbox primitives, plus the dashboard and CLI; no rclone backend is documented.
chaining: A top-level CPU or GPU Function spawns nested CPU or GPU Sandboxes for untrusted agent actions, with runtime controls for retries, budgets and loop breakers around the call.

limits.value: $5.00 a month of CPU Functions and CPU Sandboxes usage on Free, then $0.00001667 per GB-second and $0.20 per million requests
3 cron jobs on Free, and 3 on Pro; GPU Sandboxes bill $0.0000126 per vCPU-second, $0.00000137 per GB-second and $0.00013067 per GPU-second
bandwidth out is $0.09 per GB for both CPU and GPU Functions and Sandboxes

limits_note: Sandboxes run for up to 24 hours. Pro adds dedicated resources and 20 GB of model storage; storage above that is $0.39 per GB-month. The signup page reads 'Buildfunctions · v0.1.8 · Beta'.
binding_note: The $5 monthly CPU usage credit binds first on Free: GPU Sandboxes have no stated free allowance, so any GPU run is paid from the start.

identity_cost.detail: The signup form at www.buildfunctions.com/signup shows a 'Create account' link with Email, Password and 'Show password', plus 'Or continue with' for other providers. No phone or document field appears; the page does not show a card field, and the card gate inside the dashboard is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: The service labels itself beta (v0.1.8) on the signup page; bandwidth out is metered at $0.09 per GB and model storage beyond the included amount at $0.39 per GB-month. Post-run sandbox file retention is unpublished.
confidence_note: All rates, the $5 free monthly CPU usage, the 24-hour sandbox limit and the signup fields are quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-11-25. Sandbox retention, endpoint and in-dashboard card terms are unverified: behind a sign-up.
